in_hebrew.name: אוריך
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word אור (aur) meaning 'light' or 'bright'. It is not a common name in the Bible, but the root אור (aur) appears frequently in the Old Testament.

in_greek.name: Αυρικός
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word αὔριος (aurios) meaning 'dawn' or 'morning light'. It is not a common name in the Bible, but the root αὔριος (aurios) is used in the New Testament.

in_latin.name: Auricus
in_latin.long_meaning: A name derived from the Latin word aurum (gold) or aurora (dawn). It is not a common name in the Bible, but it has been used in Christian tradition for saints.
